tagline: Lucrezia embodies a pragmatic and watchful soul, shaped by a life of hard-won progress
bio: Lucrezia Dardi was born to the scent of brine and the grind of stone on stone, a daughter of the Facchini. Her early life was one of calloused hands and a strong back, hauling goods through the labyrinthine calli of Venice, her mind absorbing the city's secret rhythms—the ebb and flow of cargo, the whispers of need and surplus.
